headline: Slovakia has approved Tesla's supervised Full Self-Driving system, Tesla said, and one news site counts it as the ninth European country to allow the software.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: a national approval announced by Tesla, still a driver-assistance system and one step in a wider EU decision.
importance_line: Tesla owners in Slovakia could soon use the software while still having to supervise it, and the approval adds to Tesla's push for an EU-wide decision, though the approval is announced by Tesla and an EU vote is still pending.
summary: Reuters reports that Slovakia approved Tesla's Full Self-Driving system, according to a post by the company on X on Friday 16 Oct 2026. Not a Tesla App, a Tesla-focused news site, counts Slovakia as the ninth European country to approve the software, which remains driver assistance that the driver must supervise, and says an EU-wide vote has been delayed to December.
notes: Reuters page returned 401; the Reuters wire text was read on Global Banking & Finance Review and the detail (ninth country, December EU vote) on Not a Tesla App, a fan news site, so those details are attributed to it. Approval is announced by Tesla; policy item, no machine shown operating.
